QC_notes: The deposited matrix contains a large sample-specific lower-bound pile-up near -3.3; negative values and detection flags are retained explicitly.
PCA does not cleanly separate the three groups. No sample was removed based on its position in PCA.
Low-detection features remain in the test family, so nominal or adjusted significance must be interpreted together with detection flags.
interpretation: Exploratory probe-level secondary analysis; low detection is explicitly flagged. The two pairwise contrast families and the omnibus family have separate BH correction; no pooled FDR guarantee is claimed.
